sentences.en: Hello?
sentences.zh: 喂？

sentences.en: Oh hello.
sentences.zh: 哦，你好。

sentences.en: I was hoping to speak to Jack Fitzgerald about renting a cottage.
sentences.zh: 我想跟杰克·菲茨杰拉德联系一下，咨询租用小屋的事。

sentences.en: I，m his wife, Shirley, and we own the cottages together, so I'm sure I can help you.
sentences.zh: 我是他的妻子雪莉，我们共同拥有这些小屋，所以我想我肯定能帮上您的忙。

sentences.en: Great.
sentences.zh: 太好了。

sentences.en: My name's Tom.
sentences.zh: 我叫汤姆。

sentences.en: Some friends of ours rented Granary Cottage from you last year, and they thought it was great.
sentences.zh: 我们的一些朋友去年从你们这儿租了谷仓小屋，他们觉得非常棒。

sentences.en: So my wife and I are hoping to come in May for a week.
sentences.zh: 所以我和我妻子打算五月份去住一周。

sentences.en: What date did you have in mind?
sentences.zh: 您心里有确定的日期吗？

sentences.en: The week beginning the 14th, if possible.
sentences.zh: 如果可能的话，我们想从14号那周开始。

sentences.en: I'll just check ...
sentences.zh: 我来查一下……

sentences.en: I'm sorry, Tom, it's already booked that week.
sentences.zh: 抱歉，汤姆，那一周已经订出去了。

sentences.en: It's free the week beginning the 28th. though, for seven nights.
sentences.zh: 不过，28号那周是空着的，可以住七晚。

sentences.en: In fact, that's the only time you could have it in May.
sentences.zh: 事实上，五月里您唯一能入住的时间就是那一周。

sentences.en: Oh.
sentences.zh: 哦。

sentences.en: Well, we could manage that, I think.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我想我们也可以安排那个时间。

sentences.en: We'd just need to change a couple of things.
sentences.zh: 我们只需要调整几件事。

sentences.en: How much would it cost?
sentences.zh: 租金是多少？

sentences.en: That's the beginning of high season，so it'd be £550 for the week.
sentences.zh: 那是旺季的开始，所以一周要550英镑。

sentences.en: Ah.
sentences.zh: 啊。

sentences.en: That's a bit more than we wanted to pay, Tm afraid.
sentences.zh: 恐怕这比我们原本打算支付的要高一些。

sentences.en: We've budgeted up to £500 for accommodation.
sentences.zh: 我们为住宿预算的上限是500英镑。

sentences.en: Well, we've just finished converting another building into a cottage, which we're calling Chervil Cottage.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们刚刚把另一栋建筑改造成了小屋，我们把它叫做香芹小屋。

sentences.en: Sorry?
sentences.zh: 抱歉？

sentences.en: What was that again?
sentences.zh: 您刚才说的是什么？

sentences.en: Chervil.
sentences.zh: 香芹。

sentences.en: C-H-E-R-V for Victor l-L.
sentences.zh: C-H-E-R-V（V字代表Victor），I-L。

sentences.en: SHIRLEY： TOM： SHIRLEY： TOM： SHIRLEY： TOM： SHIRLEY： TOM： SHIRLEY： TOM： SHIRLEY： TOM： SHIRLEY： TOM： SHIRLEY： Oh, that's a herb, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 雪莉：汤姆：雪莉：汤姆：雪莉：汤姆：雪莉：汤姆：雪莉：汤姆：雪莉：汤姆：雪莉：汤姆：雪莉：哦，那是一种香草，对吧？

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: It grows fairly wild around here.
sentences.zh: 它在这附近长得比较野生。

sentences.en: You could have that for the week you want for £480.
sentences.zh: 您想要的那一周，可以以480英镑租下它。

sentences.en: OK.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So could you tell me something about it, please?
sentences.zh: 那么，您能给我介绍一下它的情况吗？

sentences.en: Of course.
sentences.zh: 当然可以。

sentences.en: The building was built as a garage.
sentences.zh: 这栋建筑原本是作为车库建造的。

sentences.en: It's a little smaller than Granary Cottage.
sentences.zh: 它比谷仓小屋略小一些。

sentences.en: So that must sleep two people, as well?
sentences.zh: 所以它应该也只能住两个人，对吗？

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: There's a double bedroom.
sentences.zh: 里面有一间双人卧室。

sentences.en: Does it have a garden?
sentences.zh: 它有花园吗？

sentences.en: Yes, you get to it from the living room through French doors, and we provide two deckchairs.
sentences.zh: 是的，您可以通过客厅的落地窗到达那里，我们提供两把躺椅。

sentences.en: We hope to build a patio in the near future, but I wouldn't like to guarantee it'll be finished by May.
sentences.zh: 我们希望在不久的将来建造一个露台，但我不敢保证它能在五月前完工。

sentences.en: TOM： SHIRLEY： TOM： SHIRLEY： TOM： SHIRLEY： OK.
sentences.zh: OK。

sentences.en: TOM： SHIRLEY： The front door opens onto the old farmyard, and parking isn't a problem- there's plenty of room at the front for that.
sentences.zh: 前门通向旧农场院落，停车不是问题——前面有充足的空间供停车。

sentences.en: There are some trees and potted plants there.
sentences.zh: 那里有一些树木和盆栽植物。

sentences.en: What about facilities in the cottage?
sentences.zh: 小屋内的设施情况如何？

sentences.en: It has standard things like a cooker and fridge, I presume.
sentences.zh: 我想它应该配备了标准设施，比如炉灶和冰箱。

sentences.en: In the kitchen area there's a fridge-freezer and we've just put in an electric cooker.
sentences.zh: 厨房区域配备了一台冰箱-冰柜，我们刚刚安装了一台电炉。

sentences.en: Is there a washing machine?
sentences.zh: 有洗衣机吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 有。

sentences.en: There's also a TV in the living room, which plays DVDs too.
sentences.zh: 客厅里还有一台电视机，也可以播放DVD。

sentences.en: The bathroom is too small for a bath, so there's a shower instead.
sentences.zh: 浴室太小，无法安装浴缸，因此配备的是淋浴设施。

sentences.en: I think a lot of people prefer that nowadays, anyway.
sentences.zh: 我想如今很多人其实更喜欢这样。

sentences.en: TOM： SHIRLEY： TOM： SHIRLEY： Audioscripts It's more environmentally friendly, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 它更环保，不是吗？

sentences.en: Unless you spend half the day in it!
sentences.zh: 除非你一整天都泡在浴缸里！

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: What about heating?
sentences.zh: 供暖情况如何？

sentences.en: It sometimes gets quite cool at that time of year.
sentences.zh: 那段时间有时会相当凉爽。

sentences.en: There's central heating, and if you want to light a fire, there's a stove.
sentences.zh: 配有中央供暖系统；如果您想生火，室内还有一台炉具。

sentences.en: We can provide all the wood you need for it.
sentences.zh: 我们可以为您提供所需的全部木柴。

sentences.en: It smells so much nicer than coal, and it makes the room very cosy- we've got one in our own house.
sentences.zh: 木柴的味道比煤炭好闻得多，而且能让房间非常温馨——我们自己家里就装有一台。

sentences.en: That sounds very pleasant.
sentences.zh: 听起来非常舒适。

sentences.en: Perhaps we should come in the winter, to make the most of it!
sentences.zh: 也许我们应该冬天来住，以便充分享受这种体验！

sentences.en: Yes, we find we don't want to go out when we've got the fire burning.
sentences.zh: 是的，我们发现壁炉燃起后，根本不想出门。

sentences.en: There are some attractive views from the cottage, which I haven't mentioned.
sentences.zh: 小屋还有一些我尚未提及的宜人景观。

sentences.en: There's a famous stone bridge- it's one of the oldest in the region, and you can see it from the living room.
sentences.zh: 那里有一座著名的石桥——它是该地区最古老的石桥之一，从客厅就能看到。

sentences.en: It isn't far away.
sentences.zh: 距离并不远。

sentences.en: The bedroom window looks in the opposite direction, and has a lovely view of the hills and the monument at the top.
sentences.zh: 卧室窗户朝向相反方向，可欣赏到山丘及山顶纪念碑的优美景色。

sentences.en: Well, that all sounds perfect.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这一切听起来都很完美。

sentences.en: I'd like to book it, please.
sentences.zh: 我想预订它。

sentences.en: Would you want a deposit?
sentences.zh: 您需要支付押金吗？

sentences.en: Yes, we ask for thirty percent to secure your booking, so that'll be, um, £144.
sentences.zh: 是的，我们需要您预付30%的订金以确认预订，即……144英镑。

sentences.en: And when would you like the rest of the money?
sentences.zh: 那么剩余款项您希望何时支付？

sentences.en: You're coming in May, so the last dav of March, please.
sentences.zh: 您将在五月入住，所以请于三月三十一日前付清。

sentences.en: Fine.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Excellent.
sentences.zh: 太好了。

sentences.en: Could I just take your details ...
sentences.zh: 我可以记录一下您的详细信息……
